Air Quality and Weather Bulletin for Delhi (06.11.2026)

दिल्ली के लिए वायु गुणवत्ता और मौसम बुलेटिन (06.11.2026)

1. Past Weather and Air Quality Observation: The air quality over Delhi was in the Very Poor category with CPCB AQI 369 at 4PM on 05.11.2026. There has been no large change in maximum and minimum temperatures over Delhi during the past 24 hours. The maximum temperatures were in the range of 27-30°C and the minimum temperatures are in the range 17-18°C respectively during past 24 hours over Delhi. The minimum temperatures are appreciably above normal (3.1°C to 5.0°C) at isolated places, above normal (1.6°C to 3.0°C) at a few places and normal (-1.5°C to 1.5°C) over remaining parts of Delhi during the past 24 hours. The maximum temperatures were appreciably below normal (-3.1°C to -5.0°C) at isolated places, below normal (-1.6°C to - 3.0°C) at isolated places and normal (-1.5°C to 1.5°C) over remaining parts of Delhi during the past 24 hours. Shallow fog was reported at Safdarjung airport. Safdarjung reported lowest visibility 700m from 0630 to 0930 IST, which gradually improved to 800m at 1000 IST of today, 06.11.2026. Mainly clear sky with surface wind speeds up to 15 kmph from the west direction prevailed over Delhi during past 24 hours. Mainly clear sky with surface wind speeds up to 15 kmph from the west directions prevailed during forenoon over the region today.
